Load the necessary Libraries
```{r}
library(car)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
```

Load Player data set
```{r}
player_stats <- read.csv("../dataset/players.csv")
```

Load Salaries data set, take mean salary over entire career
```{r}
salaries <- read.csv("../dataset/salaries_1985to2018.csv")

calculate_average_salaries <- function(data) {
  # Ensure the data is in a data frame
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  
  # Calculate average salary for each player
  result <- aggregate(salary ~ player_id, data, mean)
  
  # Rename the salary column to average_salary
  names(result)[names(result) == "salary"] <- "average_salary"
  
  # Arrange by player_id
  result <- result[order(result$player_id), ]
  
  return(result)
}

calculate_sum_salaries <- function(data) {
  # ensure data is in a data frame
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  
  # Calculate average salary for each player
  result <- aggregate(salary ~ player_id, data, sum)
  
  # Rename the salary column to average_salary
  names(result)[names(result) == "salary"] <- "total_salary"
  
  # Arrange by player_id
  result <- result[order(result$player_id), ]
  
  return(result)
}

average_salaries <- calculate_average_salaries(salaries)
total_salaries <- calculate_sum_salaries(salaries)
```

Combine both data sets by the index
```{r}
combined_data <- player_stats %>%
  left_join(average_salaries, by = c("X_id" = "player_id"))

combined_data2 <- combined_data %>%
  left_join(total_salaries, by = c("X_id" = "player_id"))
```

Select the necessary data columns, change column names
```{r}
select_data <- combined_data2 %>%
  mutate(
    Average_Salary = average_salary,
    Total_Salary = total_salary,
    Points = as.numeric(career_PTS),
    Assists = as.numeric(career_AST),
    Rebounds = as.numeric(career_TRB),
    Player_Efficiency_Rating = as.numeric(career_PER),
    Effective_Field_Goal_Percentage = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", career_eFG.)) / 100,
    Win_Shares = as.numeric(career_WS),
    Player_Position = strsplit(as.character(position), " and "),
  ) %>%
  select(name, Player_Position, Average_Salary, Total_Salary, Points, Assists, Rebounds, Player_Efficiency_Rating, Effective_Field_Goal_Percentage, Win_Shares)

colnames(select_data)[1] <- c("Name")
```

Remove rows containing NA, sort data according to name
```{r}
data_nona <- select_data %>%
  na.omit()

sorted_data <- data_nona %>% arrange(Name)

data <- sorted_data
```

Fit linear regression in terms of points, rebounds, assists
```{r}
direct_model <- lm(formula = Average_Salary ~ Points + Rebounds + Assists, data = data)
summary(direct_model)
vif(direct_model)

data$log_Avg_Salary <- log(data$Average_Salary)
direct_model_log <- lm(log_Avg_Salary ~ Points + Rebounds + Assists, data = data)
summary(direct_model_log)

data$sqrt_Avg_Salary <- sqrt(data$Average_Salary)
direct_model_sqrt <- lm(sqrt_Avg_Salary ~ Points + Rebounds + Assists, data = data)
summary(direct_model_sqrt)
```

Points
```{r}
points_model <- lm(Average_Salary ~ Points, data = data)
summary(points_model)

points_model_log <- lm(log_Avg_Salary ~ Points, data = data)
summary(points_model_log)

points_model_sqrt <- lm(sqrt_Avg_Salary ~ Points, data = data)
summary(points_model_sqrt)

points_model_poly <- lm(sqrt_Avg_Salary ~ Points + I(Points^2), data = data)
summary(points_model_poly)
```

```{r}
create_model_plot <- function(model, x_var, y_var, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes_string(x = x_var, y = y_var)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, color = "red") +
    labs(title = title, x = x_var, y = y_var) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r}
plot_points <- create_model_plot(points_model, "Points", "Average_Salary", "Points vs Average Salary")
plot_rebounds <- create_model_plot(rebounds_model, "Rebounds", "Average_Salary", "Rebounds vs Average Salary")
plot_assists <- create_model_plot(assists_model, "Assists", "Average_Salary", "Assists vs Average Salary")

plot_per <- create_model_plot(efficiency_model, "Player_Efficiency_Rating", "Average_Salary", "PER vs Average Salary")
plot_efg <- create_model_plot(field_goal_model, "Effective_Field_Goal_Percentage", "Average_Salary", "eFG% vs Average Salary")
plot_ws <- create_model_plot(ws_model, "Win_Shares", "Average_Salary", "Win Shares vs Average Salary")

basic_stats_plots <- grid.arrange(plot_points, plot_rebounds, plot_assists, ncol = 3, top = "Basic Stats Models")
advanced_stats_plots <- grid.arrange(plot_per, plot_efg, plot_ws, ncol = 3, top = "Advanced Stats Models")

all_plots <- grid.arrange(basic_stats_plots, advanced_stats_plots, direct_model_plots, advanced_model_plots, ncol = 1)

```
